performance_scope.settings: 3840x2160 Very High, HD Lands 1.4.0, clouds/reflections/shadows enabled, first person
performance_scope.method: Real separate simulation worker, stationary and forward/backward traversal. Rendered with force_draw(false) to exclude the local Linux desktop presentation bottleneck. No claim of measured GPU timestamps. Final pair has no script profiling and no screenshot readback between phases.
performance_scope.script_profile_pair: diagnostic-detail vs candidate2; root reveal safeguard and mutable-shader-cache guard subsequently added
performance_scope.final_pair: linked (preview.1 plus owner-motion fix) vs exact release PCK
performance_scope.earlier_trial_limit: Initial profiled pair captured screenshots between phases; the resulting boundary stalls remain in its wall-frame distributions and must not be credited to game changes.

persistence.result: No resurrection reproduced in supplied Mines quicksave. Two dead and two looted animals survive new-process reload, 33 seconds of simulation, village roundtrip, separate-worker save, and another fresh frontend/worker restart.
persistence.checkpoint_history: Additional live tiger IDs first occur after the authored zone12dm2 population is added. Earlier zone12dm1 and zone12dm2 waves are distinct populations. Their presence alone does not show a resurrected saved enemy.

enemy_visibility.change: Reveal refresh now dirties the unit root before the figure, so an FTI traversal cannot start with only a child while the parent retains a hidden-period interpolation cache. No AI, position or navigation changes.
enemy_visibility.checks: Rendered native boar and wolf with authority/replica placement; hidden movement followed by stationary reveal. Real new-game idle and supplied entrance-save idle/pause/reveal probes.
enemy_visibility.reproduction: The large intermittent video jump has not been reliably reproduced on this Linux renderer. Baseline idle/reveal can also pass. This is a targeted cache safeguard, not a claim that every reported jump has been reproduced or eliminated.

limits: Windows/D3D12 and RTX 4090 laptop performance were not measured.
The final timed render does not include desktop compositor/presentation time.
Short first-person Mines traversals are not a whole-campaign performance guarantee.
Enemy teleport remains intermittently unconfirmed; rendered checks establish correct placement for tested sequences only.
The supplied save did not reproduce resurrection; scripted population replacement is preserved.
